scanNote:
GRAMMAR 61-BET. Unit 14 — should/shouldn't, must/mustn't, can/can't.

1-mashqda 6 ta belgi bor (A-F). Skaner bilan tekshirildi, HAMMASI TO'G'RI:
  A = piyoda yurish taqiqlangan (chizilgan odam)
  B = o'ngga burilish taqiqlangan (chizilgan strelka)
  C = kirish taqiqlangan (qizil doira, oq ko'ndalang chiziq)
  D = velosipedda yurish taqiqlangan
  E = qo'l tekkizish taqiqlangan
  F = axlat tashlash taqiqlangan (chizilgan odam axlat tashlayapti)

  Gaplar bilan: 1=F, 2=A, 3=D, 4=B, 5=C, 6=E.

⚠ C belgisi — xalqaro 'No entry' belgisi. Unda hech qanday rasm yo'q, faqat oq ko'ndalang chiziq. Shuning uchun uni faqat ma'nosidan topish mumkin.

2 va 4-mashqlar ham tekshirildi — to'g'ri.
  2: should, should, shouldn't, should, shouldn't, shouldn't, should, shouldn't, should, shouldn't.
  4: must, mustn't, shouldn't, can't, Can, should, shouldn't, mustn't, should, can't.

⚠ 4-mashqning 10-bandi qoidani ko'rsatadi: savol 'CAN I go to the cinema?' bo'lsa, javob ham CAN bilan bo'ladi — 'No, you CAN'T'. 'Shouldn't' bu yerda mos kelmaydi, chunki savol RUXSAT so'rayapti, maslahat emas.

⚠ 3-mashq — mushuk parvarishi. Kitobda ✓/✗ belgisi berilmagan (Workbook 57-betdagi it mashqidan farqli), shuning uchun har bandning ma'nosidan kelib chiqiladi: leave outside for a long time va forget to fill water bowl — SHOULDN'T; qolganlari SHOULD.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures to their meanings.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI YO'L BELGISI (A-F):

  A  Qizil doira ichida CHIZIB TAShLANGAN
     PIYODA figurasi
  B  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     O'NGGA BURILISh strelkasi
  C  Qizil doira, o'rtasida OQ GORIZONTAL
     chiziq (klassik 'KIRISh TAQIQLANGAN'
     belgisi)
  D  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     VELOSIPEDChI
  E  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     QO'L (biror narsaga tegayotgan)
  F  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     odam AXLAT tashlayapti


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Don't throw rubbish.   →  F
  2  Don't walk.            →  A
  3  Don't ride your bike.  →  D
  4  Don't turn right.      →  B
  5  Don't enter.           →  C
  6  Don't touch.           →  E


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR RASMDAGI ASOSIY
FIGURA:

  PIYODA        →  walk      (yurmoq)
  STRELKA       →  turn      (burilmoq)
  OQ CHIZIQ     →  enter     (kirmoq)
  VELOSIPED     →  ride      (minmoq)
  QO'L          →  touch     (tegmoq)
  AXLAT         →  throw     (tashlamoq)


DIQQAT — 'C' BELGISI:
  Qizil doira + oq gorizontal chiziq —
  butun dunyoda 'NO ENTRY' (kirish taqiqlangan)
  degani. Ichida hech qanday rasm yo'q,
  faqat chiziq.

  Bu belgi bir tomonlama ko'chalarda va
  taqiqlangan kirish joylarida turadi.


DIQQAT — YO'L BELGILARINING TILI:
  Belgilar odatda BUYRUQ MAYLIDA yoziladi:
     'Don't enter.'  /  'No entry.'
     'Don't walk.'   /  'No pedestrians.'

  Ikki xil shakl:
     DON'T + fe'l    (buyruq)
     NO + ot         (qisqa e'lon)

  Misollar:
     No smoking.     = Chekish taqiqlanadi.
     No parking.     = Mashina qo'yish taqiqlanadi.
     No entry.       = Kirish taqiqlanadi.
     No swimming.    = Suzish taqiqlanadi.

  DIQQAT: 'NO + -ING' shakli!
     'No smoking'  ✓
     'No smoke'    ✗


BELGILARNI MODAL BILAN AYTISh:
  Har bir belgini 'mustn't' bilan ham aytish
  mumkin (Coursebook 101-betdagi qoida):

     F  →  You mustn't throw rubbish here.
     A  →  You mustn't walk here.
     D  →  You mustn't ride your bike here.
     B  →  You mustn't turn right.
     C  →  You mustn't enter.
     E  →  You mustn't touch.

  'mustn't' — chunki bular QONUNIY taqiq
  (Grammar 60-bet: 'it is against the rule').


DIQQAT — 'TO ENTER' PREDLOGSIZ:
  'enter the room'      ✓
  'enter INTO the room' ✗

  'enter' o'timli fe'l — to'ldiruvchi
  to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keladi.


DIQQAT — 'TO RIDE':
  ride a bike / a horse / a motorbike
  ride → RODE → RIDDEN (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  Mashina uchun 'ride' emas, 'DRIVE':
     drive a car  ✓
     ride a car   ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to throw rubbish = axlat tashlamoq
  to walk          = yurmoq, piyoda yurmoq
  to ride a bike   = velosiped minmoq
  to turn right    = o'ngga burilmoq
  to enter         = kirmoq
  to touch         = tegmoq
  a meaning        = ma'no
  a sign           = belgi

pairs.whyUz:
F belgisida odam AXLAT tashlayapti va rasm
chizib tashlangan.

Coursebook 99-betdagi varaqa bilan bog'liq:
'Do not drop rubbish in the street.'

Modal bilan: 'You mustn't throw rubbish here.'

A belgisida PIYODA figurasi chizib tashlangan.

Bu belgi piyodalar o'tishi taqiqlangan
joylarda turadi (masalan, avtomagistralda).

Qisqa shakli: 'NO PEDESTRIANS'.

D belgisida VELOSIPEDCHI chizib tashlangan.

'to RIDE a bike' — velosiped minmoq
(ride → RODE → RIDDEN).

DIQQAT: mashina uchun 'ride' emas, 'DRIVE'
('drive a car').

B belgisida O'NGGA BURILISH strelkasi
chizib tashlangan.

'to turn RIGHT / LEFT' — predlog YO'Q
('turn to the right' ham to'g'ri, lekin
yo'l belgisida qisqa shakl ishlatiladi).

pairs.rightUz: Qizil doira, o'rtasida oq gorizontal chiziq
pairs.whyUz:
C belgisi — butun dunyoda tanilgan
'NO ENTRY' (kirish taqiqlangan) belgisi.
Ichida rasm yo'q, faqat oq chiziq.

DIQQAT: 'enter the room' ✓,
'enter INTO the room' ✗ (predlog kerak emas).

pairs.rightUz: Biror narsaga tegayotgan qo'l chizib tashlangan
pairs.whyUz:
E belgisida biror narsaga TEGAYOTGAN QO'L
chizib tashlangan.

Bu belgi muzeylarda, ko'rgazmalarda va xavfli
uskunalarda turadi.

'Don't touch!' = Tegmang!

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  SHOULD      (meva-sabzavot — foydali)
   2  SHOULD      (ko'zoynak — himoya qiladi)
   3  SHOULDN'T   (og'zi to'la gapirish — qo'pol)
   4  SHOULD      (imtihon oldidan o'qish — foydali)
   5  SHOULDN'T   (zararli ovqat — zarar)
   6  SHOULDN'T   (o'rmonda olov — xavfli)
   7  SHOULD      (uy vazifasi — foydali)
   8  SHOULDN'T   (aerozol — ozonga zarar)
   9  SHOULD      (kasal — shifokorga borish)
  10  SHOULDN'T   (ko'p shirinlik — zarar)

  Ya'ni: SHOULD — 1, 2, 4, 7, 9 (5 ta)
         SHOULDN'T — 3, 5, 6, 8, 10 (5 ta)


OLTIN QOIDA — QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  Ish FOYDALI bo'lsa       →  SHOULD
  Ish ZARARLI/QO'POL bo'lsa →  SHOULDN'T

  Boshqa hech qanday grammatik belgi yo'q —
  faqat MA'NO.


HAR BIRINING KELIB ChIQIShI (Coursebook'dan):

   1  'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.'
      — CB 98-bet, 1-mashq (health)
   2  'Always wear sunglasses.'
      — CB 103-bet, 17-mashq
   3  'Don't talk with your mouth full.'
      — CB 100-bet (Angliya)
   5  'junk food' — GB 60-bet misoli
   6  'Never light fires in forests.'
      — CB 99-bet, varaqa
   7  'You must do your homework.'
      — CB 102-bet, 13b namunasi
   8  'Do not use aerosols.'
      — CB 99-bet, varaqa
   9  'See the dentist / call the doctor'
      — CB 101-bet, 9b

  Ya'ni butun mashq unitni takrorlaydi.


DIQQAT — 5-BAND, EGA 'PETER':
  'PETER shouldn't eat so much junk food.'

  Ega III shaxs birlik bo'lsa ham,
  'should' O'ZGARMAYDI:
     'Peter shouldn't' ✓
     'Peter shouldnS't' ✗
     'Peter doesn't should' ✗


DIQQAT — 'SO MUCH' va 'SO MANY':
   5  'so MUCH junk food'  — SANALMAYDIGAN
  10  'so MANY sweets'     — SANALADIGAN

  much + sanalmaydigan (food, water, money)
  many + sanaladigan    (sweets, books, cars)

  'so' — kuchaytiruvchi ('shunchalik ko'p').


DIQQAT — 7-BANDDA 'ALWAYS' QAYERDA:
  'You SHOULD ALWAYS do your homework.'

  Ravish MODAL bilan ASOSIY FE'L ORASIGA
  qo'yiladi:
     should ALWAYS do   ✓
     ALWAYS should do   ✗
     should do ALWAYS   (noto'g'ri emas, lekin
                         g'alati)


DIQQAT — 9-BAND, 'GO TO A DOCTOR':
  'He should go to A doctor.'
  Artikl 'A' — qaysi shifokor ekani muhim emas.
  'go to THE doctor' — o'z shifokoringiz.

  'isn't feeling well' — Present Continuous,
  chunki VAQTINChA holat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  junk food       = zararli tez ovqat
  sweets          = shirinliklar
  a test          = nazorat ishi
  to feel well    = o'zini yaxshi his qilmoq
  aerosols        = aerozollar

items.sentence: 1  You .................. eat lots of fruit and vegetables.
items.uz: Ko'p meva va sabzavot yeyishingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Meva-sabzavot yeyish — FOYDALI ish → SHOULD.

Coursebook 98-betdagi 1-mashqning c-bandi
aynan shu edi:
'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.' (health)

items.sentence: 2  You .................. wear sunglasses at the beach.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Ko'zoynak ko'zni himoya qiladi — FOYDALI → SHOULD.

Coursebook 103-bet, 17-mashq:
'Always wear sunglasses. They protect your eyes
from the sun.'

'sunglasses' — DOIM ko'plikda.

items.sentence: 3  You ..................... talk with your mouth full.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Og'zi to'la gapirish — QO'POL → SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni:
'Don't talk with your mouth full.'

'with + ot + SIFAT' qurilmasi.

items.sentence: 4  A: I have a test tomorrow.  B: You ..................... stay at home and study.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Imtihon oldidan o'qish — FOYDALI → SHOULD.

KONTEKST KALITI: 'I have a TEST tomorrow' —
bu yordamga muhtoj holat, demak IJOBIY
maslahat beriladi.

'stay AT home' — artikl YO'Q.

items.sentence: 5  Peter ..................... eat so much junk food.
items.uz: Piter bunchalik ko'p zararli ovqat yemasligi kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Zararli tez ovqat — ZARAR → SHOULDN'T.

DIQQAT — EGA 'PETER' (III shaxs birlik):
'should' baribir O'ZGARMAYDI!
  'Peter shouldn't' ✓
  'Peter doesn't should' ✗

'so MUCH junk food' — 'food' SANALMAYDIGAN,
shuning uchun 'much'.

items.sentence: 6  People ..................... light fires in the forests.

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'rmonda olov — XAVFLI → SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 99-betdagi varaqa:
'Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.'

'to light a fire' — light → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

Uy vazifasi — FOYDALI → SHOULD.

Coursebook 102-bet, 13b-mashq namunasi:
'You must do your homework.'

DIQQAT — 'ALWAYS' QAYERDA:
'You should ALWAYS do ...' ✓
'You ALWAYS should do ...' ✗
Ravish modal bilan asosiy fe'l ORASIDA.

Aerozol ozon qatlamiga ZARAR beradi → SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 99-betdagi varaqa:
'Do not use aerosols. They pollute the air.'

Coursebook 98-bet, 3-mashq:
'Do not use aerosols.'

items.sentence: 9  A: Tim isn't feeling well.  B: He .......................................... go to a doctor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Kasal odam shifokorga borishi — FOYDALI → SHOULD.

KONTEKST KALITI: 'Tim ISN'T FEELING WELL' —
yordam kerak, demak IJOBIY maslahat.

Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'Call the doctor.'

'isn't feeling' — Present Continuous, chunki
VAQTINCHA holat ('doesn't feel' ham to'g'ri).

'go to A doctor' — qaysi shifokor ekani
muhim emas.

Ko'p shirinlik — tishga va sog'liqqa ZARAR
→ SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 102-bet, 16d-dialog:
'No, you can't. They're bad for your teeth.'

DIQQAT — 'SO MANY' (5-bandda 'so MUCH' edi):
  many + SANALADIGAN  (sweets)
  much + SANALMAYDIGAN (junk food)

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using should or shouldn't, as in the example. — HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT
exercises.instructionUz: Namunadagidek should yoki shouldn't bilan gap tuzing. — MUSHUKNI QANDAY PARVARISH QILISH KERAK
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA:
  'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT'
  (Mushugingizni qanday parvarish qilish kerak)

RASM: kattakon ko'zli, yo'l-yo'l mushukcha.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  feed/twice a day
    → You SHOULD feed your cat twice a day.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  leave/outside for a long time
    → You SHOULDN'T leave your cat outside for
      a long time.

 3  take/to the vet every six months
    → You SHOULD take your cat to the vet every
      six months.

 4  forget/to fill water bowl
    → You SHOULDN'T forget to fill its water
      bowl.

 5  empty/litter tray once a week
    → You SHOULD empty its litter tray once a
      week.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Mushugingizni kuniga ikki marta
    ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
 2  Mushugingizni uzoq vaqt tashqarida
    qoldirmasligingiz kerak.
 3  Mushugingizni har olti oyda veterinarga
    olib borishingiz kerak.
 4  Uning suv idishini to'ldirishni
    unutmasligingiz kerak.
 5  Uning hojatxona lotogini haftada bir marta
    tozalashingiz kerak.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  MUSHUKKA FOYDALI  →  SHOULD    (1, 3, 5)
  MUSHUKKA ZARARLI  →  SHOULDN'T (2, 4)

     1  ovqatlantirish     — foydali
     2  uzoq tashqarida qoldirish — xavfli
     3  veterinarga olib borish — foydali
     4  suvni unutish      — zararli
     5  lotokni tozalash   — foydali


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitob chiziqcha bilan qisqa ko'rsatma
  bergan. To'liq gapda EGALIK olmoshi va
  ARTIKL qo'shiladi:

     feed/twice a day
       → feed YOUR CAT twice a day

     leave/outside
       → leave YOUR CAT outside

     take/to the vet
       → take YOUR CAT to the vet

     forget/to fill water bowl
       → forget to fill ITS water bowl

     empty/litter tray
       → empty ITS litter tray


DIQQAT — 'ITS' va 'IT'S' FARQI:
  ITS   = uning (EGALIK olmoshi)
          'its water bowl' = uning suv idishi
  IT'S  = it is / it has (QISQARTMA)
          'it's cold' = sovuq

  Bu — inglizchadagi eng ko'p qilinadigan
  yozma xato!
  Egalik olmoshida APOSTROF YO'Q:
     its ✓   it's ✗ (egalik ma'nosida)


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI IKKI INKOR EMAS:
  'You SHOULDN'T FORGET to fill ...'
  = unutmasligingiz kerak
  = ya'ni ESLAB QOLISHINGIZ kerak

  'shouldn't forget' — ikki inkor emas,
  chunki 'forget' o'zi inkor emas.

  Boshqacha aytish mumkin:
     'You should REMEMBER to fill its water
      bowl.' (bir xil ma'no)


DIQQAT — 'FORGET TO' va 'FORGET -ING':
  'forget TO DO' = qilishni unutmoq
     (qilinmagan)
  'forget DOING' = qilganini unutmoq
     (qilingan, lekin esdan chiqqan)

  Bu yerda 'forget TO FILL' — suvni quyish
  hali qilinmagan.


DIQQAT — TAKRORLANISh IBORALARI:
  TWICE a day      = kuniga ikki marta
  ONCE a week      = haftada bir marta
  EVERY six months = har olti oyda
  three TIMES a day = kuniga uch marta

  DIQQAT: 'once' va 'twice' — maxsus so'zlar
  ('one time', 'two times' kam ishlatiladi),
  lekin uchdan boshlab 'three TIMES'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to take care of = parvarish qilmoq
  to feed         = ovqatlantirmoq
                    (feed → FED)
  twice a day     = kuniga ikki marta
  to leave        = qoldirmoq (leave → LEFT)
  outside         = tashqarida
  a vet           = veterinar (mol shifokori)
  to fill         = to'ldirmoq
  a bowl          = kosa, idish
  to empty        = bo'shatmoq, tozalamoq
  a litter tray   = mushuk hojatxonasi (lotok)
  once a week     = haftada bir marta


DIQQAT — 'LITTER' SO'ZINING IKKI MA'NOSI:
  Coursebook 103-betda:
     'LITTER' = ko'chadagi axlat
     'Don't drop litter on the beach.'

  Bu yerda:
     'a LITTER TRAY' = mushuk hojatxonasi
     (ichiga maxsus qum solinadi)

  Bir so'z, ikki butunlay boshqa ma'no —
  KONTEKST hal qiladi.

points.en: 1  feed/twice a day  →  You should feed your cat twice a day.
points.uz: Mushugingizni kuniga ikki marta ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'to feed' → FED (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'TWICE a day' = kuniga ikki marta.

points.en: 2  leave/outside for a long time  →  You shouldn't leave your cat outside for a long time.
points.uz: Mushugingizni uzoq vaqt tashqarida qoldirmasligingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
ZARARLI → SHOULDN'T.
'to leave' → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'FOR a long time' — davomiylik.

points.en: 3  take/to the vet every six months  →  You should take your cat to the vet every six months.
points.uz: Mushugingizni har olti oyda veterinarga olib borishingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
FOYDALI → SHOULD.
'a vet' = veterinar (veterinarian qisqartmasi).
'take somebody TO somewhere' — predlog 'to'.

points.en: 4  forget/to fill water bowl  →  You shouldn't forget to fill its water bowl.
points.uz: Uning suv idishini to'ldirishni unutmasligingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
ZARARLI (suvsiz qolish) → SHOULDN'T.

'ITS' — egalik olmoshi, APOSTROF YO'Q!
('it's' = it is — BOSHQA so'z)

'forget TO fill' — hali qilinmagan ish.

points.en: 5  empty/litter tray once a week  →  You should empty its litter tray once a week.
points.uz: Uning hojatxona lotogini haftada bir marta tozalashingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
FOYDALI → SHOULD.
'to empty' — bu yerda FE'L (bo'shatmoq),
sifat emas.

DIQQAT: 'litter' bu yerda 'axlat' emas,
mushuk lotogidagi QUM ma'nosida
(CB 103-betdagi 'litter' dan farqli).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  MUST
   2  MUSTN'T
   3  SHOULDN'T
   4  CAN'T
   5  CAN
   6  SHOULD
   7  SHOULDN'T
   8  MUSTN'T
   9  SHOULD
  10  CAN'T


UCh SAVOL — HAR BANDDA:

  1) Ma'no IJOBIY mi, SALBIY mi?
  2) MAJBURIYAT mi, MASLAHAT mi, RUXSAT mi?
  3) QONUN/QOIDA mi, shaxsiy fikr mi?


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'You MUST be quiet in class.'
    Jim bo'lish — IJOBIY qoida.
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa ma'no TESKARI bo'lardi
    ('jim bo'lmasligingiz kerak').
    → MUST
    (CB 102-bet, 13a: 'You must be quiet in
     class.')

 2  'When in China, you MUSTN'T kiss anyone in
     public.'
    Xitoyda bu QO'POL — TAQIQ.
    'must kiss' bo'lsa 'o'pishingiz shart'
    degan kulgili ma'no chiqadi.
    → MUSTN'T
    (CB 100-bet, Xitoy matni)

 3  'People SHOULDN'T smoke because it's bad
     for their health.'
    KALIT: 'BECAUSE IT'S BAD' — sabab
    salbiylikni ko'rsatib turibdi.
    → SHOULDN'T

 4  'Speak louder, please. I CAN'T hear you.'
    KALIT: 'Speak LOUDER' — demak hozir
    eshitilmayapti.
    'I can hear you' bo'lsa balandroq gapirish
    kerak bo'lmasdi.
    → CAN'T

 5  'CAN I have a glass of water, please?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS, majburiyat
    emas.
    'Must I have a glass of water?' =
    'suv ichishim shartmi?' — ma'nosiz.
    → CAN

 6  'You SHOULD keep your room tidy.'
    Xonani ozoda tutish — IJOBIY.
    'mustn't' bo'lsa 'ozoda tutmasligingiz
    kerak' degan teskari ma'no chiqadi.
    → SHOULD

 7  'You SHOULDN'T buy pre-packaged food.'
    O'ralgan ovqat ko'p chiqindi hosil qiladi
    — SALBIY.
    → SHOULDN'T
    (CB 99-bet: 'Try NOT to buy pre-packaged
     food.')

 8  'You MUSTN'T fight in class.'
    Urishish — TAQIQLANGAN.
    'can fight' bo'lsa 'urishishingiz mumkin'
    degan ma'no chiqadi.
    → MUSTN'T
    (CB 102-bet, 13a: 6-o'quvchi)

 9  'A: I'm tired.  B: You SHOULD go to bed
     early.'
    KALIT: 'I'M TIRED' — yordam kerak, demak
    IJOBIY maslahat.
    → SHOULD
    (CB 101-bet, 9b: 'Get some sleep.')

10  'A: Can I go to the cinema?
     B: No, you CAN'T.'
    OLTIN QOIDA: QISQA JAVOB savoldagi
    MODALNI TAKRORLAYDI.
       'CAN I ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa savolga mos kelmaydi.
    → CAN'T


ENG MUHIM UCh KALIT:

  A) MA'NO IJOBIY MI?
     ijobiy → must / should / can
     salbiy → mustn't / shouldn't / can't

  B) QISQA JAVOB SAVOLNI TAKRORLAYDI (10-band)
     'Can I ...?' → 'No, you can't.'

  C) KONTEKSTDAGI SABAB (3, 4, 9-bandlar)
     'because it's bad'  → shouldn't
     'Speak louder'      → can't
     'I'm tired'         → should


MUST va SHOULD FARQI (1 va 6-bandlar):
   1  'You MUST be quiet in class.'
      → QOIDA (maktab qoidasi, majburiy)
   6  'You SHOULD keep your room tidy.'
      → MASLAHAT (yumshoqroq)

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini yonma-yon bergan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  tidy          = ozoda, tartibli
  to keep tidy  = ozoda tutmoq
  louder        = balandroq
  to hear       = eshitmoq (hear → HEARD)
  health        = sog'liq
  the cinema    = kinoteatr
  a glass of water = bir stakan suv

items.textEn: 1  You must/shouldn't be quiet in class.
items.whyUz:
Jim bo'lish — IJOBIY maktab QOIDASI → MUST.

'shouldn't' bo'lsa ma'no TESKARI bo'lardi:
'jim bo'lmasligingiz kerak'.

Coursebook 102-bet, 13a-mashq:
'You must be quiet in class.'
(bu ham IJOBIY ko'rsatmalardan biri edi)

items.textEn: 2  When in China, you mustn't/must kiss anyone in public.
items.uz: Xitoyda odamlar oldida hech kimni o'pmasligingiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
Xitoyda bu QO'POL hisoblanadi → MUSTN'T (taqiq).

'must kiss' bo'lsa 'o'pishingiz SHART' degan
kulgili ma'no chiqadi.

Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
'When in China, don't kiss anyone in public —
it's very rude.'

items.textEn: 3  People should/shouldn't smoke because it's bad for their health.
items.uz: Odamlar chekmasligi kerak, chunki bu sog'liqqa zarar.
items.whyUz:
KALIT — SABAB GAPI:
'BECAUSE IT'S BAD for their health'

Sabab salbiy, demak maslahat ham salbiy
→ SHOULDN'T.

Bu bandda javob gapning ICHIDA berilgan —
taxmin qilish shart emas.

items.textEn: 4  Speak louder, please. I can't/can hear you.
items.whyUz:
KALIT — BIRINCHI GAP:
'SPEAK LOUDER, please' — demak hozir
ESHITILMAYAPTI.

Agar 'I CAN hear you' bo'lsa, balandroq
gapirish kerak bo'lmasdi — mantiqan zid.

'to hear' → HEARD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'louder' — 'loud' ning qiyosiy darajasi.

items.textEn: 5  Must/Can I have a glass of water, please?
items.whyUz:
KALIT — 'PLEASE':
Bu ILTIMOS, majburiyat emas → CAN.

'Must I have a glass of water?' =
'suv ichishim SHARTMI?' — ma'nosiz savol.

Rasmiyroq shakl: 'MAY I ...?' yoki
'COULD I ...?'

items.textEn: 6  You should/mustn't keep your room tidy.
items.whyUz:
Xonani ozoda tutish — IJOBIY ish → SHOULD.

'mustn't' bo'lsa ma'no TESKARI:
'xonangizni ozoda tutmasligingiz kerak' —
kulgili.

DIQQAT — 1-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  1  'You MUST be quiet' — QOIDA (majburiy)
  6  'You SHOULD keep tidy' — MASLAHAT (yumshoq)

'tidy' = ozoda, tartibli.

items.uz: Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmasligingiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
O'ralgan ovqat ko'p CHIQINDI hosil qiladi
— SALBIY → SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 99-betdagi varaqa:
'TRY NOT TO buy pre-packaged food.
The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.'

'must buy' bo'lsa 'sotib olishingiz shart'
degan teskari ma'no chiqadi.

Urishish — TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

'can fight' bo'lsa 'urishishingiz MUMKIN'
degan ma'no chiqadi — maktab qoidasiga zid.

Coursebook 102-bet, 13a-mashq, 6-o'quvchi:
'You mustn't fight in class.'

'to fight' → FOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

items.textEn: 9  A: I'm tired.  B: You should/mustn't go to bed early.
items.whyUz:
KALIT — 'I'M TIRED':
Charchagan odamga YORDAM kerak, demak
IJOBIY maslahat → SHOULD.

'mustn't go to bed early' = 'erta yotish
taqiqlangan' — charchagan odamga aytiladigan
gap emas.

Coursebook 101-bet, 9b va 10-mashq:
'I feel very tired.' → 'You should get some
sleep.'

items.textEn: 10  A: Can I go to the cinema?  B: No, you shouldn't/can't.
items.whyUz:
OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI MODALNI
TAKRORLAYDI:

  'CAN I go ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'
  'SHOULD I go ...?' → 'No, you SHOULDN'T.'

Savol 'CAN' bilan boshlangan, demak javob ham
'CAN'T' bo'ladi.

Coursebook 101-bet, 12-mashq namunasi:
'Can I play loud music?' — 'No, you can't.'

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 61-bet — belgilar, maslahat va mushuk parvarishi.

groups.explanationUz: Ikki shakl: DON'T + fe'l, yoki NO + -ING.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't enter. / No entry. Don't touch. Don't turn right.
patterns.explanationUz:
Belgi va e'lonlar tili.
'NO + -ING' shaklida:
No smoking, No parking, No swimming.

patterns.exampleEn: You should always do your homework. Peter shouldn't eat so much junk food.
patterns.exampleUz: Doim uy vazifangizni bajarishingiz kerak. Piter bunchalik ko'p zararli ovqat yemasligi kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ravish (always) MODAL bilan ASOSIY FE'L
ORASIDA turadi.
Ega III shaxs bo'lsa ham 'should' o'zgarmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: You should feed your cat twice a day. You should take your cat to the vet every six months.
patterns.exampleUz: Mushugingizni kuniga ikki marta ovqatlantirishingiz kerak. Har olti oyda veterinarga olib borishingiz kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qisqartma ko'rsatmani to'liq gapga
aylantirish: EGALIK olmoshi va ARTIKL
qo'shiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: You shouldn't forget to fill its water bowl.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning suv idishini to'ldirishni unutmasligingiz kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
= 'You should REMEMBER to ...'
'forget TO do' — hali qilinmagan ish.
'ITS' — apostrofsiz egalik olmoshi.

patterns.formula: CAN I + [ASOSIY fe'l] ... ?  —  No, you CAN'T.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I go to the cinema? — No, you can't.
patterns.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi MODALNI takrorlaydi.
'Can I ...?' → 'you can't'
('you shouldn't' — savolga mos kelmaydi).
